name: Azuma Youko
source:
Hajime's mother and Shinpei's wife. She is always cheerful. She is an ex-delinquent so some traces still remain - she has a sharp tongue and will send fists flying if she gets angry. She is in charge of cooking at Mana.

[Based on [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/タペストリー_-you_will_meet_yourself-]Wikipedia[/url]]
